entities.name: Pantothenic acid
observations: Pantothenic acid (vitamin B5) deficiency is classically associated with burning feet syndrome; the syndrome is rare.

entities.name: PMID:38187802
observations: A 2023 scoping review identifies burning feet syndrome among manifestations of pantothenic acid deficiency.

entities.name: Burning feet syndrome
observations: Severe burning or numb sensations in the feet are the classic nutritional clue for pantothenic acid deficiency, although deficiency is rare and other deficiencies may coexist in malnutrition.
